script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are showing a powerful tension in your chart right now. Uranus forms a challenging square to your 4th House of Home and Roots today, creating significant disruption in your foundational stability and sense of security. This aspect urges you to deeply examine why you feel restless despite your usual independent nature and questioning spirit. As for relationships, expect sudden, unexpected connections through unconventional friendships that will challenge your traditional views on partnership and loyalty. In the workplace, your 10th House receives a beneficial sextile from Saturn, bringing disciplined structure and long-term vision to your innovative projects and career goals. Be cautious of overcommitting to new ventures before fully understanding their implications and testing them thoroughly. The warning is to avoid rushing into commitments without grounding yourself in your established foundations and proven methods. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
